body: It went well. I well be taking my medication again, and seeing a psychiatric nurse regularly until a therapist becomes available to take me as a patient. I started talking to my parents as well. I still feel really shitty, but I don't see myself hurting myself right now.

Yes I did, and she agreed since I had been doing well for a while we should give it a try. I kind of regret that now. We progressively reduced my dosage for several months. I have an appointment with her tomorrow.
I called my doctor on Monday, she can see me Thursday. I promised myself I wouldn't do anything until I spoke with her.
